name: AWS infrastructure with Terraform
description: AWS infrastructure managed by Terraform, with explicit account, state, plan, and apply boundaries.

definitions.name: Purpose
definitions.defaultText: Make only the agreed AWS infrastructure change. Define the expected resource and operational outcome before editing.

definitions.name: Target environment
definitions.defaultText: Identify the AWS account ID, region, Terraform workspace, and state backend or key. Confirm the active identity before any cloud-backed plan.

definitions.name: Resource scope
definitions.defaultText: Edit only the named root module and resources. Trace dependent resources and identify any planned replacement or deletion.

definitions.name: Credentials and secrets
definitions.defaultText: Use the existing IAM role or profile and least-privilege access. Do not print credentials or commit secrets, state files, or saved plans.

definitions.name: Terraform state
definitions.defaultText: Inspect the configured backend and locking. Never reset, force-unlock, import, move, or manually edit state without separate approval.

definitions.name: Local checks
definitions.defaultText: Run terraform fmt -check and terraform validate in the affected root. Run configured TFLint or security checks if present; do not silently introduce tools.

definitions.name: Plan review
definitions.defaultText: With authorized cloud access, run terraform plan using the intended workspace and variables. Review creates, updates, replacements, deletes, IAM, and cost-sensitive changes. Do not expose secrets from the plan.

definitions.name: Apply approval
definitions.defaultText: Show the account, region, workspace, state target, and reviewed plan. Wait for explicit approval before terraform apply, destroy, or any state mutation.

definitions.name: Apply
definitions.defaultText: After approval, use the existing deployment pipeline or apply the reviewed plan. Stop if the plan changed and request a new review.

definitions.name: Proof
definitions.defaultText: After an authorized apply, verify Terraform outputs and relevant AWS resource health. Report actual changes, failures, and recovery limits; do not claim deployment after planning alone.
